answer: Persistent History Ledger. Each new identity must replay a randomized history of past interactions, scored against a shared record. A real agent's history sits at a stable vertex of consistency; a clone's fabricated past drifts and fails the check. Honest agents pay nothing beyond ordinary activity. An attacker must reconstruct plausible history for every clone, and that work grows with each identity.
